# `ktx compile`

- **Usage**: `ktx compile [-o --output <OUTPUT>] [--self-contained] <SCRIPT>`

## Arguments

### `<SCRIPT>`

## Flags

### `-o --output <OUTPUT>`

Output path. With --self-contained this is a directory; otherwise a jar file (defaults to &lt;script>.jar next to the script).

### `--self-contained`

Bundle a minimal JRE alongside the fat jar so end users do not need Java installed. Output is a directory tree (host platform only).
